what: the tree player, fitted on the fresh test's fitting episodes and its form chosen on its validation episodes

setting.reward: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.
setting.when: the evenly spread looks, as least sure

trees.loss: log-loss on each tile's reward over the best tile's

validation.rule: the form with the larger mean round gain on the validation episodes, ties to the learned player's inputs; the differences to least sure and to the learned player in use decide nothing
